cases.trigger: All ten read the same root clock while lighting changes.
cases.required_result: One clock identity; NPC reads never advance it; native physics delta and health/route/quiet timers remain real time.
cases.evidence: Clock identity/day/hour per sample plus native physics/frame timestamps.

cases.required_result: Day increases once at midnight, never merely at dawn; daylight rates300/150s per hour preserved; full cycles not discarded.
cases.evidence: Bounded pure native clock checks, explicitly separate from physical passage acceptance.

cases.trigger: Use actual N day/night transition, repeat N during transition, and cancel transition with T.
cases.required_result: No repeated day increments after crossing24; no catch-up burst of missed purchases. T pauses schedule time only; real support/threat/death checks continue.
cases.evidence: Native input path or actual control method; frame-by-frame day/hour, tickets and receipts.

cases.trigger: Observe morning, lunch, evening and sleep windows for all ten stable source IDs.
cases.required_result: Individual meal/shop/wake/sleep times and late schedules are present. No all-ten departure caused by a single shared threshold; no old random wander fallback.
cases.evidence: Per-ID schedule table, chosen need/reason, departures, arrivals and rests.

cases.trigger: Assign all ten original residents to real shared homes.
cases.required_result: Each home has1–3 residents, enough distinct physical beds, valid destructible building identity; one current owner per bed; no unassigned ID or duplicate bed claim.
cases.evidence: Home/body/bed paths, assignments and exact generation-bound lease inventory.

cases.trigger: Resident travels home, enters through door, approaches assigned bed, sleeps, wakes and exits.
cases.required_result: Native movement throughout entry/exit; sleep starts only after real arrival/support and pose ownership. World/floor/door/player collision contract retained.
cases.evidence: Positions, phases, cached contacts, actual door fractions, native ticks and pose-commit proof.

cases.trigger: Hunger, planned meal/shop and low funds select a real venue; rest follows completed activity.
cases.required_result: Actual bank/service transaction precedes routine completion; energy restores only through existing authenticated receipt path. Failed/cancelled request is not marked complete.
cases.evidence: Goal ticket, pending purpose, staff interaction, receipt identity/amount, balance before/after and physical exit.

cases.trigger: Jump over meal windows/day rollover while a bank/payment/entry/exit is pending.
cases.required_result: Active service retains original ticket until terminal release; one committed payment per ticket. Skipped windows do not enqueue a backlog; new day is reconsidered after safe unwind.
cases.evidence: Original and resumed ticket IDs, unique receipt IDs, account ledger and route ownership.

cases.trigger: Trigger authentic shot/hit/death during home approach, sleep and bench rest.
cases.required_result: Existing medical/combat/threat priorities win; home/bench movement and pose authority release; death immediately retires old generation with no stale claim or later payment.
cases.evidence: Native damage/shot events, frame of cancellation, lease release, threat/hospital movement, respawn generation.

cases.trigger: Remove physical bed support or destroy its house during approach and sleep, including while T is paused.
cases.required_result: Sleep and its pose cancel on support/identity loss; real falling/blocked exit remains physical. Bounded recovery or explicit unavailable reason; no sleeping in air or stale bed claim.
cases.evidence: Actual destruction event, support lifecycle, contacts, health, phase and claim snapshots.

cases.trigger: Use an existing available OriginalBench, then interrupt or remove its support.
cases.required_result: Existing exact physical reservation, approach/dock/pose checks remain. No invented bench/seat or pose without committed support; cancellation releases exact lease.
cases.evidence: Bench registry lease, native approach/dock positions, pose frames and support-removal cancellation.

cases.trigger: Observe the final combined source with ten originals plus twelve staff.
cases.required_result: Motion idle≤10s and queue idle≤30s; required motion confined within1.5m for30s fails even through retries. Valid sleep/rest excluded only with live owner/support proof; every due journey moves. No FPS acceptance beside user game.
cases.evidence: Exact SOURCE/HARNESS archive, native frame-time/physics timeline, spatial audit, cached slides, memory/object counters and per-ID transitions.

execution_plan: Pure native clock/idempotence checks first; no city instance needed.
Short targeted native component cases for homes/support/priority/time jumps through real owners.
Only after integration, ordinary ten-resident observation on the exact combined source with frozen harness and updated home-phase diagnostics.

A1200s ordinary run cannot prove a full5400s day. With current17.5start, it mainly covers evening/early night; morning/lunch require explicit controlled production-clock windows or a separately authorized full-day run.
